label: SPECIMEN
_evidence: DERIVED from real config.json byte/param accounting (memory-safe, not allocated); anchored on the 30B-A3B nameplate. NOT an mlx runtime measurement.
note: Replaces the failed gpu subprocess (odyssey_patient_runner --nx-gather 'exited-no-receipt'). The gather quantity is an architecture formula; loading the 30B in mlx was unnecessary and would have contended with the sealed-3.14 resident (one-27B law).
lever: selected-expert gather (K of E experts/token) dominates per-token weight cost

measured_cross_ref.interpretation: the measured number is derived from measured active BYTES / active_bpw and so carries quant scales+zeros, KV, and activation buffers; it is ~1.16x the clean weight-param count. They are DIFFERENT quantities -- not forced equal (CP3).

finding: Only 11.0% of the 30B is active/token. 95.0% of the model is expert weight, but only 8/128 experts are gathered per token, so the gather is 54.0% of per-token active compute. Resident memory must hold all 128 experts; per-token bandwidth touches only 8. This quantifies R-sparse-active-expert-gather.
